label: MONEY STORY
hook: Ritu and Sameer wanted a ₹60,000 family trip, without a loan.

slides.text: They dreamed of a family holiday next summer, costing about ₹60,000.
slides.sub: Ritu and Sameer are an illustrative example

slides.text: So they divided it by the months they had.
Every salary day, ₹6,000 moved automatically into a separate 'trip' savings account.
Ten months later, they travelled with the full amount ready and nothing to repay.
Lesson: big goals feel small when you divide them by months.
Try this today: pick one goal, divide its cost by months, and start this salary day.
